verdict.rationale: Capacities' own AI-privacy documentation says AI features are fully opt-in and that no space data goes to third-party AI services unless AI is activated. That keeps data away from external AI providers. However, the evidence never mentions model training: there is no no-training commitment for users who enable AI, and nothing on whether Capacities itself trains on user content. missing for 10: explicit no-training guarantee, training opt-out that works while AI features stay enabled, statement on vendor-side training, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: AI features in Capacities are fully opt-in. If you do not activate AI, no data from your spaces is shared with any third-party AI services.
